meta.title: Start a deal
meta.description: Source a product, supply a product or offer a trade service. Build it by tapping, preview exactly what each party sees, then submit for Ponte review.

structure.trust: Build and preview freely. Join only when you save or submit.

intent.title: What do you want to do?
intent.buyDesc: I need to buy or import
intent.serviceDesc: Freight, customs, inspection, finance or another trade service

facts.reward: Ponte structured {facts} facts. {gaps} details still needed.

classify.chooseCategory: Choose the closest category. You can add detail afterwards.
classify.choosePartner: Choose the partner or channel type.
classify.chooseRelationship: How would the arrangement be structured? Choose any that apply.
classify.noOptionMatch: No option matches that. Choose Other to describe it in your own words.
classify.describeServiceNeed: Describe the trade service you need
classify.describeServiceOffer: Describe the trade service you provide
classify.describeHint: Ponte keeps your wording and still records the category you chose.
classify.detailsOptional: Optional. Route, volume, timing, certifications, target customer or commercial conditions.
classify.detailsPlaceholder: Anything that helps a counterparty judge the fit
classify.sectorOptional: Optional. Choose a sector if you know it.
classify.relationshipOptional: Optional. Leave this open if it is negotiable.

ask.destination: Where does it need to go?
ask.validity: How long does this stay open?

preview.title: See exactly what each party sees.
preview.publicNote: What buyers see before an introduction. Identity withheld.
preview.privateNote: Held by Ponte. Never shown publicly.
preview.reviewerNote: What a Ponte reviewer assesses. Dated evidence, never a score.

submit.title: Ready when the record is.
submit.sub: {n} things must be resolved before Ponte can publish. You can save a draft now and finish later.

blocker.quantityDesc: A decisive fact a reviewer needs before publication.
blocker.incotermDesc: The delivery basis must be stated to publish.
blocker.validityDesc: Ponte publishes only opportunities with a stated horizon.
blocker.roleDesc: State the role you act in for this opportunity.
blocker.businessVerificationDesc: Publication needs a current member-business verification. You can still submit for review now.

received.title: Opportunity submitted for review
received.body: Ponte will review the structured record before anything is published.
received.draftBody: Your draft is saved privately. Finish and submit it whenever you are ready.

error.title: Ponte kept your words.
error.body: Something interrupted the submission. Nothing you tapped is lost. Try again.
